title: LAW ZOO // LAB
claim: A notebook for named relations between mined tiny laws. Two specimens selected; lib/interphase-ring.js names the relation with the same four control verbs the FOLD//BLOOM convergence lane consumes (BLOOM / FOLD / RETURN / SPLIT).
why_this_is_a_sibling_and_not_a_donor_ch: The five LAW ZOO machines are FROZEN_DONOR — their identity is exact bytes. This page does not read, write, or modify them. It carries RECEIVED vocabulary only (specimen ids, names, dominant lens) and links out to the field guide for actual play. LAW ZOO's own law requires 'shared principle, no forced shared runtime', so the fold lives at the algebra/relation layer and must never become a runtime merge.
contribution_note: Supplies a mechanism (relation naming from the ring algebra) to an existing head without replacing it. Argument for DELTA rather than UNRESOLVED: the head changed is the LAW ZOO family child set, which is a registered object; no frozen file is touched. Left for the operator/INDEX owner to confirm the class.
